description:

name: agent-governance-toolkit
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        microsoft /

      agent-governance-toolkit  

    
      AI Agent Governance Toolkit — Policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, and reliability engineering for autonomous AI agents. Covers 10/10 OWASP Agentic Top 10.
summary: 该项目是微软开源的AI代理治理工具包，提供策略执行、零信任身份、执行沙箱及可靠性工程功能，覆盖OWASP代理安全Top 10全部风险，值得关注因为它为自主AI代理的安全治理提供了企业级解决方案。

name: claude-video
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        bradautomates /

      claude-video  

    
      Give Claude the ability to watch any video. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, hands it all to Claude.
summary: 该项目让Claude能够“观看”视频：通过下载、提取帧和转录，将视频内容交给Claude分析。值得关注是因为它突破了AI处理视频的边界，使Claude能理解动态视觉信息。

name: airi
description:
Star


  

  
    
    


      
        moeru-ai /

      airi  

    
      💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.
summary: Airi 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，支持实时语音聊天和玩《我的世界》《异星工厂》等游戏，跨平台运行，因其类似 Neuro-sama 的交互能力和完全自主可控的特性而值得关注。
